# Break : exercices de Kegel

> Break is a free iPhone app (iOS) for Kegel / pelvic floor exercises, for men and women. It sends discreet reminders (1 to 5 a day) and guides each 2–4 minute session with an animated circle, vibrations and sound or voice cues, including with the phone locked. No account, no ads, no data collection: everything stays on the device. Available in French and English. Published by Open River Labs LLC (Newark, Delaware, USA — https://openriverlabs.app/). Android version coming soon on Google Play.

## Key facts
- Session: 10 slow squeezes (3, 5, 7 or 10 seconds depending on level) then 10 quick squeezes; 2 to 4 minutes.
- Recommended: 3 sessions a day; goal adjustable from 1 to 5.
- 4 levels; automatic level-up after 7 successful days.
- Reminders use neutral text ("Take 2 min") and a 30-minute snooze.
- Price: free. No subscription.
